# Master Frame

> **Lock sentence:** DR-GU is a hybrid system. ChatGPT governs the SQL/Supabase half. Claude governs the Obsidian infinite brain interface. Both halves obey the same canonical rules.

## What Changed

This vault was radically restructured on 2026-05-14. The changes are **fundamental**, not cosmetic.

The prior vault treated DR-GU as a temporal governance system with five clocks. That remains true and is preserved. But the restructuring reveals that DR-GU is something deeper:

> **DR-GU computes relational identity under closure.**

The scalar readout — the "bit" — is the last step, not the first.

## The Core Reversal: Bit-from-It

Wheeler's "it from bit" says: information (bits) are primitive; reality derives from them.

DR-GU reverses this:

```text
Bit-from-It:
  relation first
  closure second
  admissibility third
  scalar readout last
```

A bit is the compressed admissibility readout of a prior relational identity carrier. It cannot originate identity.

See: [[Bit-from-It Computation Axiom]]

## The Hybrid Frame

```text
Supabase (ChatGPT) ←→ Obsidian (Claude)
         ↕                    ↕
    SQL tables          .md notes
    migrations          wikilinks
    dashboards          lock chains
    validators          temporal governance
         ↕                    ↕
           BST as shared guardrail
```

BST is the governing guardrail for both halves. Every object must be bi-directionally addressable through BST.

See: [[BST Registry]], [[Bidirectional BST Embedding Guardrail]]
